# Collectors

Every collector of `ucode-prometheus-exporter 0.1.0`. A collector's name is what a scrape's `collect[]=` takes and the suffix of its package; its section in `/etc/config/prometheus-exporter` is named after its module, the name with `_` for `-`. Its options are in that section; [UCI configuration](uci-config.md#collector-sections) has the section's rules.

## Packages {#packages}

The base package, `ucode-prometheus-exporter`, installs `conntrack`, `cpu`, `entropy`, `exporter`, `filefd`, `loadavg`, `meminfo`, `netclass`, `netdev`, `openwrt_interfaces`, `selinux`, `softnet`, `time`, `timesync`, `uname`, `vmstat`. Every other collector is a package of its own, `ucode-prometheus-exporter-<name>`, which depends on the base package of the same release. A group package installs no files, only its collectors.

| Group package | For | Collectors |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ucode-prometheus-exporter-network` | network statistics | `ethtool`, `nat_traffic`, `netstat`, `nft-counters`, `qdisc`, `snmp6`, `sockstat` |
| `ucode-prometheus-exporter-wireless` | Wi-Fi | `hostapd_stations`, `hostapd_ubus_stations`, `wifi` |
| `ucode-prometheus-exporter-hardware` | hardware and filesystems | `diskstats`, `filesystem`, `hwmon`, `thermal` |
| `ucode-prometheus-exporter-full` | a router or access point | `ethtool`, `nat_traffic`, `netstat`, `nft-counters`, `qdisc`, `snmp6`, `sockstat`, `hostapd_stations`, `hostapd_ubus_stations`, `wifi`, `diskstats`, `filesystem`, `hwmon`, `thermal`, `dhcp_leases`, `dnsmasq`, `openwrt`, `textfile`, `uci_dhcp_host`, `wireguard` |

In no group: `bmx7`, `chrony`, `dawn`, `ltq-dsl`, `modemmanager`, `mwan3`, `realtek-poe`, `ubnt-manager`, `unbound`.

## Nothing to observe {#nothing-to-observe}

These collectors can have nothing to observe: they succeed without samples, and their `node_scrape_collector_observing` is 0. Every other collector fails when it cannot read what it reads. The reasons are what `check`, the ubus object's `status` and LuCI's status page show.

| Collector | Nothing to observe when | Reasons it gives | Still a failure |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [`bmx7`](#bmx7) | bmx7 disabled, or not installed. | `bmx7 is disabled`, `bmx7 is not installed` | bmx7 enabled, and its status files unreadable. |
| [`chrony`](#chrony) | chronyd disabled, or not installed. | `chronyd is disabled`, `chronyd is not installed` | chronyd enabled, and `chronyc` failing (chronyd stopped). |
| [`conntrack`](#conntrack) | nf\_conntrack not loaded: none of its files in `/proc/sys/net/netfilter`. | `no connection tracking (nf_conntrack is not loaded)` | Its files there and unreadable. |
| [`dawn`](#dawn) | DAWN disabled, or not installed. | `dawn is disabled`, `dawn is not installed` | DAWN enabled, and its `dawn` object missing or failing. |
| [`dhcp_leases`](#dhcp_leases) | dnsmasq (or no dnsmasq instance in `/etc/config/dhcp`) and odhcpd both disabled or not installed. With one of them enabled, it observes that one. | `dnsmasq is disabled`, `dnsmasq is not installed`, `odhcpd is disabled`, `odhcpd is not installed` | An enabled server that is not there: no dnsmasq lease file, odhcpd not on ubus. |
| [`diskstats`](#diskstats) | Every block device in `/proc/diskstats` is one `device_exclude` leaves out (by default flash, loop devices, zram and partitions): a router without a disk. Or no block device at all. | `device_exclude leaves out every block device`, `no block devices` | `/proc/diskstats` not there or unreadable; a line of a device it exports that is malformed. |
| [`dnsmasq`](#dnsmasq) | dnsmasq disabled, or not installed. | `dnsmasq is disabled`, `dnsmasq is not installed` | dnsmasq enabled, and its `dnsmasq` object missing or failing. |
| [`hostapd_stations`](#hostapd_stations) | As wifi, or no `hostapd.<ifname>` object for any interface. | `no wireless radios`, `no hostapd access points` | A hostapd object that does not answer. |
| [`hostapd_ubus_stations`](#hostapd_ubus_stations) | No `hostapd.*` object. | `no hostapd access points` | A hostapd object that does not answer. |
| [`ltq-dsl`](#ltq-dsl) | No `dsl` object. | `no DSL modem (no dsl on ubus)` | A `dsl` object that does not answer. |
| [`modemmanager`](#modemmanager) | ModemManager disabled or not installed, or it lists no modem. | `ModemManager lists no modems`, `modemmanager is disabled`, `modemmanager is not installed` | `mmcli` failing or running out of time with ModemManager enabled. |
| [`mwan3`](#mwan3) | mwan3 disabled, or not installed. | `mwan3 is disabled`, `mwan3 is not installed` | Its `mwan3` object failing. Enabled and stopped is a reading: `mwan3_interface_running 0`. |
| [`nat_traffic`](#nat_traffic) | nf\_conntrack not loaded: no `/proc/net/nf_conntrack`. | `no connection tracking (nf_conntrack is not loaded)` | The file there and unreadable. |
| [`realtek-poe`](#realtek-poe) | No `poe` object. | `no PoE switch (no poe on ubus)` | A `poe` object that does not answer. |
| [`snmp6`](#snmp6) | No `/proc/net/dev_snmp6` (IPv6 disabled). | `no IPv6 (no /proc/net/dev_snmp6)` | The directory there and unreadable. |
| [`timesync`](#timesync) | Neither busybox ntpd nor chronyd runs, as procd's instances say: sysntpd runs ntpd only while `/etc/config/system` turns NTP on. With one running, it observes that one. | `neither ntpd nor chronyd runs` | chronyd enabled and not running, or `chronyc` failing; busybox ntpd's event file unreadable. |
| [`ubnt-manager`](#ubnt-manager) | ubnt-manager not installed, or `ubnt-manager -l` lists no radio. | `ubnt-manager is not installed`, `ubnt-manager lists no radios` | A radio that fails or does not answer. |
| [`unbound`](#unbound) | unbound disabled, or not installed. | `unbound is disabled`, `unbound is not installed` | unbound enabled, and its control socket not answering. |
| [`wifi`](#wifi) | No `network.wireless` object, or one without radios. | `no wireless radios` | Another failed call; an interface nl80211 cannot answer for. |
| [`wireguard`](#wireguard) | rpcd has no `wireguard` object: rpcd-mod-wireguard not installed. | `rpcd has no wireguard object: rpcd-mod-wireguard is not installed` | Any other failure of `wireguard status`. |

## `bmx7` {#bmx7}

The bmx7 mesh node, its links and tunnels, from its JSON status files.

- **Title:** bmx7 mesh
- **Package:** `ucode-prometheus-exporter-bmx7`
- **Section:** `config collector 'bmx7'`
- **Needs:** `fs`, `ubus`
- **Jail paths:** `/var/run/bmx7/json`
- **Nothing to observe:** bmx7 disabled, or not installed. See [Nothing to observe](#nothing-to-observe).
- **Metrics:** [bmx7](metrics.md#bmx7)

| Option | Title | Type | Default | Datatype | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `enabled` | Enabled | boolean | `1` | — | Serve this collector; 0 leaves it out, and naming it in a query is a 400. |

## `chrony` {#chrony}

chronyd's tracking and sources, and its server statistics where it serves time, from chronyc.

- **Title:** chrony NTP daemon
- **Package:** `ucode-prometheus-exporter-chrony`
- **Section:** `config collector 'chrony'`
- **Needs:** `ubus`, `uci`, `fs`, `exec`
- **Reads the configs:** `/etc/config/chrony`
- **Runs:** `chronyc` (only where it is installed), with `/bin/sh`
- **Seconds for its programs:** The main section's `exec_timeout`, unless its section sets `timeout`
- **Nothing to observe:** chronyd disabled, or not installed. See [Nothing to observe](#nothing-to-observe).
- **Metrics:** [chrony](metrics.md#chrony)

| Option | Title | Type | Default | Datatype | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `enabled` | Enabled | boolean | `1` | — | Serve this collector; 0 leaves it out, and naming it in a query is a 400. |
| `timeout` | Program timeout | integer | `exec_timeout`'s (5) | `range(1,30)` | Seconds the programs of this collector get in all in each scrape; one still running then is killed. |

## `dhcp_leases` {#dhcp_leases}

Active DHCP leases of dnsmasq and odhcpd, by interface and family.

- **Title:** DHCP leases
- **Package:** `ucode-prometheus-exporter-dhcp_leases`
- **In the groups:** `ucode-prometheus-exporter-full`
- **Section:** `config collector 'dhcp_leases'`
- **Needs:** `fs`, `ubus`, `uci`, `time`
- **Reads the configs:** `/etc/config/dhcp`
- **Jail paths:** The lease file of each `dnsmasq` section of `/etc/config/dhcp`: its `leasefile`, or `/tmp/dhcp.leases`.
- **Nothing to observe:** dnsmasq (or no dnsmasq instance in `/etc/config/dhcp`) and odhcpd both disabled or not installed. With one of them enabled, it observes that one. See [Nothing to observe](#nothing-to-observe).
- **Metrics:** [dhcp\_leases](metrics.md#dhcp_leases)

| Option | Title | Type | Default | Datatype | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `leases` | Lease series | boolean | `0` | — | A series per lease, with its address, MAC, hostname and expiry. |
| `enabled` | Enabled | boolean | `1` | — | Serve this collector; 0 leaves it out, and naming it in a query is a 400. |

## `diskstats` {#diskstats}

Reads, writes, discards and flushes of each disk, and the time spent on them, from /proc/diskstats, as node\_exporter has them.

- **Title:** Disk I/O
- **Package:** `ucode-prometheus-exporter-diskstats`
- **In the groups:** `ucode-prometheus-exporter-hardware`, `ucode-prometheus-exporter-full`
- **Section:** `config collector 'diskstats'`
- **Needs:** `fs`
- **Nothing to observe:** Every block device in `/proc/diskstats` is one `device_exclude` leaves out (by default flash, loop devices, zram and partitions): a router without a disk. Or no block device at all. See [Nothing to observe](#nothing-to-observe).
- **Metrics:** [diskstats](metrics.md#diskstats)

| Option | Title | Type | Default | Datatype | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `device_exclude` | Excluded devices | string | `^(z?ram|loop|fd|(h|s|v|xv)d[a-z]|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+p|mtdblock|ubiblock[0-9]+_|mmcblk[0-9]+(p|boot))[0-9]+$` | `regex` | A regular expression of the block devices to leave out: by default RAM disks, zram, loop devices, flash (mtdblock, ubiblock) and the partitions of disks, whose I/O their disk counts. ^$ leaves out none. |
| `enabled` | Enabled | boolean | `1` | — | Serve this collector; 0 leaves it out, and naming it in a query is a 400. |
